description: Release contract: which git tag builds which PyMuPDF on which Alpine, and where the result may be installed.

releases.notes: PyMuPDF 1.13.x is the only line matching MuPDF 1.13. Alpine 3.9 ships mupdf 1.13.0-r2 (rebuild of the same upstream release) and python3 3.6.9, so the apk built on 3.8 installs and runs there unchanged.

verified.note: derivation run compiled in-place on 3.11 and passed tests/smoke.py + tests/feature.py; the apk still has to be produced by the release workflow

releases.notes: MuPDF 1.16 keeps freetype/harfbuzz/jpeg/openjpeg/jbig2dec/zlib symbols for the loader, so the extension must link them (build.extra_link_libs).

verified.note: derivation run compiled on 3.13 and passed tests/smoke.py + tests/feature.py after stubbing jm_valid_chars (Alpine's MuPDF is built without JavaScript); the apk still has to be produced by the release workflow

releases.notes: Alpine 3.14 has the same MuPDF 1.18 but Python 3.9, so per the version-offset rule it will take v1.18.1 (a separate build).

verified.note: same MuPDF as 3.13 but Python 3.9 -> separate build per the version-offset rule; derivation passed after adding -I/usr/include/freetype2

releases.notes: PyMuPDF 1.18.x includes <ft2build.h> itself, so CPPFLAGS needs -I/usr/include/freetype2 (later lines add it in their setup.py).

verified.note: apk built with abuild (py3-pymupdf-1.19.6-r0.apk, sha256 5ed98cfc...c5e6) and installed on Alpine 3.15.11: smoke + feature pass

releases.notes: MuPDF >= 1.19 no longer ships a separate third-party library, so the template drops it from setup.py's library list.

verified.note: apk built with abuild (py3-pymupdf-1.19.5-r0.apk, sha256 54777f8e...a551) and installed on Alpine 3.16.9 (Python 3.10): smoke + feature pass

releases.notes: MuPDF >= 1.19 no longer ships a separate third-party library, so the template drops it from setup.py's library list.

pending.reason: PyMuPDF 1.16.0 does not compile against MuPDF 1.15; PyMuPDF has no 1.15 line.
1.17.7 needs MuPDF 1.18's redact API; 1.17.0 compiles and passes smoke but segfaults on Page.firstAnnot (upstream bug).

PyMuPDF 1.21.0 no longer supports a system MuPDF: setup.py always builds MuPDF from source (PYMUPDF_SETUP_MUPDF_BUILD / _TGZ), which violates the 'dependencies come from apk' rule. Alpine also never ships MuPDF 1.20, so no PyMuPDF 1.20.x line pairs with an Alpine release.

unsupported_alpine.3.17+: PyMuPDF >= 1.21 builds its own MuPDF, not allowed by the project rule
